sources.snippet: Audio8 TTS Preview 0.6B is a .6B-parameter multilingual text-to-speech model with zero-shot voice cloning. It uses a DualAR architecture inspired by Fish Audio S2 Pro: a slow AR transformer predicts one semantic token per audio frame, and a fast AR transformer predicts the frame's codec codebooks conditioned on the slow hidden state and preceding codebooks.
